data.narrative:
Magdrive, a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Mark Stokes and Thomas Clayson, has raised $22.5M to date. The Space & Aerospace sector includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, providing partial market context though narrow direct precedent at this stage.

Stage-progression analysis is the only applicable triangulation method. Using total raised ($22.5M) as a baseline valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing round yields an implied valuation of $56M. Peer-median analysis could not be executed due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Space & Aerospace sector—while 11 same-sector companies exist in the data universe, none met the three-datapoint minimum after filtering. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 23.9x across the five public tickers) is inapplicable without Magdrive's revenue, which private companies typically do not disclose.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $48M (low) to $65M (high), with a median of $56M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for Magdrive's specific technology and execution risk profile, absence of downstream comparable financing data, and lack of revenue visibility. The single-method conclusion warrants validation against future funding events or disclosed financial metrics.
